title: Submitting a completed CFRS questionnaire produces AI framework recommendations and lands on the response detail page
description: Full path: CFRSQuestionnaireModal collects assessment metadata + per-question answers via Formik, POSTs to /smart-compliance/responses (synchronous LLM call, ~3-8s AILoadingScreen), clears the local draft, invalidates the navbar credits display, then routes to /smart-compliance/response/[id].
preconditions: Project has at least one active SCQuestion
Azure OpenAI env vars configured and at least one active ComplianceFramework exists
User has smart_compliance.create permission for the selected project
steps: Fill in the assessment Name on the metadata step and click 'Start Questions'
Answer every question, using 'Next' to advance, then click 'Submit Assessment' on the last question
Observe the AI loading screen, then the resulting navigation
expectedResult: A new SCResponse is created with a denormalized questionnaireSnapshot and a persisted recommendation.supportedFrameworks; the browser navigates to /smart-compliance/response/{responseId} showing the recommended frameworks; the localStorage draft key for this project is cleared.

title: Closing the browser mid-questionnaire preserves answers and resumes at the same step on reopen
description: DraftAutosaver writes {values, currentQuestionIndex, savedAt} to localStorage key `cfrs-questionnaire-draft:{projectId}` on every answer/step change (once the initial restore pass completes). Reopening the modal for the same project restores the saved values and step, and shows a 'Draft restored' toast.
steps: Open the questionnaire, fill assessment name, answer the first 2 questions and advance to question 3
Close the modal (or the browser tab) without submitting
Reopen /smart-compliance and click 'Start AI Assessment' again for the same project
expectedResult: A 'Draft restored' toast appears; the modal reopens on question 3 (not the metadata step) with the first two answers still populated; nothing was lost.

title: Adding an LLM-recommended framework from the response detail page activates it as an Authority Framework
description: CFRSResponseDetails.handleAddFramework resolves the frameworkId from response.enrichedSupportedFrameworks and calls POST /smart-compliance/responses/:responseId/frameworks/:frameworkId/add. On success the framework appears in CurrentAuthorityFrameworks and in the Active Frameworks tab, and grc-preferences is fire-and-forget synced.
preconditions: A submitted response recommends a licensed framework not yet active on the project
steps: Open a response detail page showing the recommended framework's card
Navigate to the 'Active Frameworks' tab on /smart-compliance
expectedResult: A 'Framework Added' toast is shown; the framework now appears under Current Authority Frameworks on the response page and in the Active Frameworks table, with status 'active'.

title: Adding a framework that was not part of a response's LLM recommendation is rejected
description: The addFramework controller checks response.recommendation.supportedFrameworks for the requested frameworkId before allowing adoption — it does not accept an arbitrary catalog frameworkId just because the user is authorized.
preconditions: A response exists whose recommendation does NOT include framework X
steps: Call POST /smart-compliance/responses/:responseId/frameworks/:frameworkIdX/add where frameworkIdX was never recommended in that response
expectedResult: 400 'Framework was not recommended in this response' — no ClientFramework document is created or reactivated.

title: An empty question catalog shows a graceful empty state instead of a broken questionnaire wizard
description: When GET /smart-compliance/questions?status=active returns zero rows, CFRSQuestionnaireModal renders 'No questions available' with a Refresh button rather than attempting to show a metadata/question step wizard with totalQuestions=0.
preconditions: No active SCQuestion documents exist (all archived or none created)
expectedResult: Modal shows 'No questions available' with a 'Refresh' button; no crash, no infinite loading spinner, and the Submit button is never reachable.

title: Reaching the yearly Smart Compliance run limit disables 'Start AI Assessment' and blocks submission server-side
description: ComplianceHeroSection.deriveScGate computes runsExhausted from the billing usage metrics and disables the button client-side with a tooltip explanation. Independently, submitResponse enforces the same runsPerYear limit server-side (SC_RUNS_EXHAUSTED, 402) so a direct API call cannot bypass the UI gate.
preconditions: Org's smartCompliance module config has a finite runsPerYear already met by prior submissions this year
steps: Load /smart-compliance and observe the 'Start AI Assessment' button and its tooltip
Attempt to call POST /smart-compliance/responses directly with a valid payload, bypassing the UI
expectedResult: The button is disabled with tooltip text containing 'Run limit reached'; the direct API call is rejected with 402 and error code SC_RUNS_EXHAUSTED — no LLM call is made and no SCResponse is created.

title: Framework Recommendations analysis aggregates recommendation frequency and average scores across multiple submitted assessments
description: getFrameworkAnalysis (GET /smart-compliance/responses/analysis) walks every active SCResponse for the project and rolls up recommendationCount, avgConfidence and avgValueScore per frameworkId, then marks isAdded from the live ClientFramework list.
preconditions: Two separate questionnaire submissions on the same project both recommend framework 'ISO 27001', with confidence 80 and 60 respectively
steps: Submit assessment #1, letting the LLM recommend ISO 27001 at confidence 80
Submit assessment #2, letting the LLM recommend ISO 27001 at confidence 60
expectedResult: ISO 27001 shows recommendationCount = 2 and avgConfidence = 70 (rounded average of 80 and 60); isAdded reflects whether it is currently active on the project.

title: A project member from a different organization cannot open a Smart Compliance response link belonging to another org
description: getResponseById calls assertOrgAccess (403 unless organization.admin) before resolveProjectScope. End-to-end check that navigating directly to another tenant's response URL fails closed rather than rendering partial data.
preconditions: Org A user has a valid session
A response ID belonging to org B is known/guessed
steps: As an org A user, navigate directly to /smart-compliance/response/{orgB-response-id}
expectedResult: Page shows the 'Error Loading Response'/'Access denied' state — no questionnaire snapshot, recommendation, or framework data from org B is rendered or present in the network response body.
